# glossary

The primary GDHCN glossary (`gdhcn.glossary.json`, folio-glossary/v1): the 21 definitions in Section II of the GDHCN Administrative and Operational Framework 1.2, quoted from the L1 copy in `library/`. The Framework is the legal source; IG-only terms go in a separate scheme and never override it. Rendered and checked by `check:glossary`.

Part of [WHO SMART Trust](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `glossary`, holding `glossary`.
